    text = request.get("text", "")
    
    # Handle null/empty input
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
        return None
    
    # Extract digits only from the string
    digits_only = ''.join(c for c in text if c.isdigit())
    
    # Check for valid US phone number patterns
    # Accepts 10 digits (e.g., "2345678901") or leading 1 with 10 more digits (e.g., "1234567890" -> should be normalized to +1XXXXXXXXXX)
    
    if len(digits_only) == 10:
        # Just normalize to US format with country code
        return f"+1{digits_only}"
    elif len(digits_only) > 10 and digits_only.startswith('1'):
        # Has leading 1, remove it for normalization (assuming first digit is area code indicator)
        normalized_digits = '1' + ''.join(c for c in digits_only[1:] if not c.isdigit())[:9]
        return f"+{normalized_digits}"
    else:
        return None
